target.title: fix(sessions): preserve titles on upsert
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Runtime `upsertSessionEntry(...)` replacement writes can omit human title metadata while refreshing session state. Before this patch, an omitted `label` or `displayName` overwrote the existing human-readable lane title, which made stable sessions fall back to opaque/generated names after routine runtime writes. This revives the narrow fix from closed PR #93072 on current `main` without carrying old release-branch noise.

## Summary

- Preserves existing non-empty `label` and `displayName` when `upsertSessionEntry(...)` receives replacement runtime metadata that omits those fields.
- Keeps explicit title replacement/clearing behavior intact, including `patchSessionEntry({ replaceEntry: true })` as the intentional full-entry clear path.
- Updates plugin SDK docs for the title-preservation contract.

## Evidence

Local verification on current `upstream/main` worktree:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/config/sessions.test.ts` - 54 passed
- `npx oxfmt --check --threads=1 docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md src/config/sessions.test.ts src/config/sessions/store.ts`
- `npx oxlint src/config/sessions.test.ts src/config/sessions/store.ts`
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`

Previous closed PR #93072 had green checks and completed ClawSweeper review before being closed as stale/ignored.
